top_signals.title: Why Bill Dudley Thinks Warsh's Approach to Fed Policy Is Flawed
top_signals.summary: Bill Dudley, a Bloomberg Opinion columnist and former president of the Federal Reserve Bank of New York, reacts to Fed Chairman Kevin Warsh's news conference following the central bank's decision to leave interest rates unchanged.  Speaking on "Bloomberg Surveillance," Dudley says Warsh's silence was "quite deafening" and markets are showing there's a loss of credibility in the Fed. (Source: Bloomberg)

top_signals.title: Minutes of the Meeting of the Court of Directors held on 4 June 2026
top_signals.summary: The Bank's Court of Directors acts as a unitary board, setting the organisation's strategy and budget and taking key decisions on resourcing and appointments. Required to meet a minimum seven times per year, it has five executive members from the Bank and up to nine non-executive members.
